scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w apps/server
